name: Evolutionary Hyperparameter Evaluation Protocol
aliases: Evolutionary Hyperparameter Evaluation Protocol — Elo-based Configuration Ranking, Population/Iteration Analysis
definition: A systematic procedure to assess how evolutionary algorithm hyperparameters (population size, iteration count) affect transfer function optimization quality using pairwise Elo ratings.
summary: The Evolutionary Hyperparameter Evaluation Protocol ranks transfer function optimization processes using pairwise Elo ratings to identify optimal hyperparameter configurations, distinct from methods that optimize the transfer function directly.
